benefits.text:
BBIA Lip Oil Balm has a concentrated level of nourishing ingredients with 5% Shea butter extract and a sweet, relaxing Vanilla scent. BBIA Lip Oil Balm helps keep lips deeply moisturized, protect and care for dry lips, revitalize chapped lips so they look plump, and remove dead skin cells.
- Daytime: When lips feel dry and rough, apply Bbia Lip Oil Balm right away and in just a moment lips will feel velvety soft and smooth, a true lip balm.
- Nighttime: Exfoliates and moisturizes lips overnight. After a long day your lips are exposed to many environmental factors, so nighttime is the best time to help your lips recover. With 2 steps using Bbia Lip Oil Balm every night, you can have plump, lively lips that every girl dreams of

howToUse.text:
You can use your finger or the dedicated spatula (included with the product) to scoop out the product
Step 1: Before sleeping, apply a layer of Bbia Lip Oil Balm onto the lips like a mask
Step 2: After waking up, use a cotton pad dampened with a little toner to wipe off the lip balm “mask” from step 1

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: Nourishing lip balm that helps lips feel soft, smooth and moisturized, suitable as a prep step before lipstick or as an overnight lip mask.

sellingPoints.text: Contains 5% Shea Butter; deeply moisturizes and softens lips; can be used during the day or as an overnight lip mask.

texture.text: Rich lip balm that melts softly onto the lips.

finish.text: Moisturized and smooth / subtle shine / soft, smooth lips.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it treats chapping, restores lips in a medical sense or removes 100% of dead skin cells. For severely peeling lips, remove makeup/care for lips regularly and avoid peeling the lips.
